correctness.rationale: For every integer d≥2 and every a strictly between 0 and 1, the exact beta marginal, conditional transverse-ball quadratic variance, and parity/O(d−1) splitting yield all six eigenvalues with dimensions adding to binomial(d+2,2). Strict beta stochastic ordering, a min-max comparison on u, and an off-diagonal nonstationarity test on 1−u place the two simple even eigenvalues outside all four other levels. The beta integral expansion and determinant identity prove the sharp factor 405/[8(d+1)(d+4)] times a^{-4}. An exact ten-by-ten rational determinant and 24 full numerical moment-spectrum comparisons were executed from the packaged scripts; finite checks do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: A central slab is a standard incomplete-volume observation region. The exact all-width, all-dimension strict ordering proves an aperture-independent absence of optimizer transitions and identifies unique best- and worst-observed quadratic polynomials without a growing matrix diagonalization. The precise a^{-4} condition-number coefficient quantifies unavoidable thin-slab instability, a natural functional spectral invariant for reconstruction and polynomial approximation.
